meta.title: Here’s your AI Fluency Review
meta.coverage_line: Based on 6 authorized work episodes across AI chats and resulting documents.

access_limits: Offline source checking was not visible unless recorded in the conversation or document.
attribution_limits: Two document edits combined human and AI text without tracked changes.

limitations: This first review does not support a comparison with an earlier period.

standouts.strongest_observed_habit: You usually gave the AI a clear audience, format, and useful source material before asking it to draft.
standouts.current_focus: Make verification visible when a source contains a number or policy claim that affects the conclusion.
standouts.try_next: Before accepting a draft, ask for a short claim-to-source table and check the two highest-risk claims yourself.

areas.observed_pattern: You regularly named the audience, desired format, source material, and completion criteria.
inconsistent_patterns: One scheduling request did not say which constraint mattered most when two preferences conflicted.
areas.rating_rationale: The behavior was attributable to you and repeated across policy, communications, planning, and analysis tasks.
areas.recommended_action: Add one sentence naming the most important trade-off when a task has competing constraints.

evidence.summary: You specified the decision audience, a one-page limit, and which evidence had to be cited.
You supplied the participant profile, timing, materials, and a clear definition of a finished agenda.

areas.observed_pattern: You kept final decisions for yourself and often asked AI to draft, organize, or surface options.
inconsistent_patterns: Review ownership was left implicit in two drafting tasks.
evidence_gaps: The records did not show how responsibilities were divided when another person joined the work.
areas.rating_rationale: Human decision ownership was visible, but approval points were not consistently stated.
areas.recommended_action: At the start, state what AI may produce, what decision stays with you, and what must be checked before use.

evidence.summary: You asked AI to organize trade-offs but explicitly retained the selection decision.

areas.observed_pattern: You questioned unsupported recommendations and caught one contradiction between a draft and its source.
inconsistent_patterns: A conflicting policy number was cited in the final draft without a visible check.
evidence_gaps: You reported verifying the policy offline, but that check was not visible in the authorized trace.
areas.rating_rationale: Several checks were visible, while a consequential numerical conflict remained reported rather than observable.
areas.recommended_action: For every consequential number, record the source line you checked and the decision you made about it.

evidence.summary: You noticed that the recommendation did not follow from the cited survey result and asked for a revision.
The trace contains your statement that you verified the policy, but not the verification itself.

areas.observed_pattern: You removed sensitive details, checked document structure, and saved a usable final artifact in most episodes.
inconsistent_patterns: One analysis ended after drafting without a recorded source check or final acceptance step.
evidence_gaps: The records did not show whether every final document was reviewed after export.
areas.rating_rationale: Responsible completion was usually visible, but the final evidence trail varied by task.
areas.recommended_action: Close each task with a three-item note: checked, changed, and ready for use.

evidence.summary: You removed participant identifiers and checked that timings added up before saving the agenda.

areas.observed_pattern: You changed your prompting approach after a weak draft and checked that the revised task produced a clearer result.
evidence_gaps: The 14-day window did not show the revised practice reused in a later comparable task.
areas.rating_rationale: A change and check were visible, but later reuse was not.
areas.recommended_action: Save the improved briefing pattern and deliberately reuse it on the next comparable task.

evidence.summary: After a generic first draft, you added decision criteria and asked AI to map each option to them.

adaptive_flexibility_change.summary: A changed approach and checked result were visible, but later reuse was not available in this first review.
